svg.title: V0 decays
svg.desc: A neutral kaon decays into two curling pions; the Armenteros-Podolanski plane; the survival probability of a neutral parent.
svg.text: V0: a neutral parent that leaves no track and decays into a V
B = 1.5 T out of the page. In isotop's chamber a fork whose parent is neutral (below the CPU threshold) draws such a vertex.
